name: Medical & Health

levels.note: MBBS/BDS degree + internship. Age 21-35. NEET PG for specialization.
MD/MS degree. Age 21-40. NEET SS for super-specialty.

stages.name: NEET PG / NEET SS
stages.tests: NEET PG: 200 Qs, 3.5 hrs. NEET SS: 100 Qs, 1.5 hrs.
stages.note: For MD/MS/super-specialty. Score determines college allocation.

stages.name: Written Exam (for non-PG posts)
stages.tests: 100-200 Qs. Medical knowledge, GK, Reasoning. For Staff Nurse, Pharmacist, etc.
stages.note: State-level exams. Some central (AIIMS, ESIC) have own exams.

stages.name: Interview / Skill Test
stages.tests: Personal interview. For MO posts: clinical knowledge + personality.
stages.note: Some posts have skill test (nursing practical, pharmacy practical).

stages.name: Document Verification
stages.tests: Degree, internship certificate, registration, caste, NOC.
stages.note: Medical registration (MCI/NMC) mandatory. Verify before applying.

reality: AIIMS and central institutes pay better than state hospitals. Prefer central if possible.
Staff Nurse (GNM) vs Nursing Officer (B.Sc Nursing): different pay levels and eligibility.
NEET PG cut-off is very high. General category needs 50th percentile minimum.
Government medical jobs have bond service (1-3 years) in many states. Check before applying.
Rural service is often mandatory for new MOs. Remote posting for 1-2 years.
Salary: MO ~₹56,100 (Level 10) + NPA (Non-Practicing Allowance). Nursing Officer ~₹44,900 (Level 7).

2 papers × 120 Qs — General Medicine, Pediatrics, Surgery, OB-GYN, Preventive & Social Medicine.

faq.q: What is the difference between Staff Nurse and Nursing Officer?
faq.a: Staff Nurse: GNM diploma, Level 7. Nursing Officer: B.Sc Nursing, Level 7 (higher entry pay). Both do patient care. Nursing Officer has better promotion prospects.

faq.q: Can a BAMS/BHMS graduate apply for allopathy MO posts?
faq.a: No. Allopathy MO requires MBBS. AYUSH graduates apply for AYUSH MO posts (BAMS/BHMS/BUMS). Separate exams and vacancies.

faq.q: What is NEET PG and is it mandatory?
faq.a: National Eligibility cum Entrance Test for Post-Graduation. Mandatory for MD/MS admission in government and private colleges. Score determines college and specialty allocation.

faq.q: What is the age limit for medical government jobs?
faq.a: MO: 21-35 years. Staff Nurse: 18-30 years. Pharmacist: 18-30 years. Age relaxations for SC/ST/OBC/PwD.

faq.q: Is there negative marking in medical exams?
faq.a: Yes. NEET PG: 4 marks correct, -1 wrong. AIIMS: 1 mark correct, -1/3 wrong. UPSC CMS: 1 mark correct, -1/3 wrong.

faq.q: Where do I find official medical job notifications?
faq.a: aiims.edu (AIIMS), upsc.gov.in (CMS), state health departments, esic.nic.in. SarkariJobs+ links the official notification on every listing.
